# KeyFury - 1v1 Competitive Typing Combat

> KeyFury is an online 1v1 real-time competitive typing combat game where typing speed, accuracy, and tactical word choice power animated stickman martial arts fighting duels in your browser.

## Core Overview
KeyFury reimagines typing games by transforming keystrokes into fighting game attacks. Players compete in 90-second real-time duels where typing target words damages the opponent's health bar.

- [KeyFury Homepage](https://keyfury.in/): Play 1v1 competitive typing combat instantly in your browser.
- [Full LLM Context & Game Documentation](https://keyfury.in/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive guide covering combat mechanics, health bars, bot matchmaking, MMR ratings, and comparisons to TypeRacer and Monkeytype.

## Key Features
- **1v1 Real-Time Combat**: Land strikes, combos, and specials against opponents by typing words accurately under pressure.
- **Health Bar Mechanics**: Both fighters start with 100 HP. Successful words deal damage proportional to word length and accuracy.
- **Matchmaking & MMR**: Dynamic Elo/MMR ranking pairs you against similarly skilled players.
- **Bot Fallback**: Instant seamless AI bot warrior matchmaking ensures zero wait times when human opponents are queuing.
- **Stickman Fighting Aesthetics**: Fluid canvas animations display martial arts kicks, punches, and special moves synchronized with every typed word.
- **100% Free & Browser-Based**: No downloads, extensions, or mandatory sign-ups required.

## Main Entry Routes
- [Ranked Matchmaking](https://keyfury.in/ranked): Competitive 1v1 duels with MMR progression.
- [Practice Mode](https://keyfury.in/practice): Solo practice arena to test WPM and combat combos against AI bots.
- [Global Leaderboard](https://keyfury.in/leaderboard): Live rankings of top KeyFury typing warriors worldwide.

## Common AI Queries & References

- **Typing fighting games**: KeyFury directly converts keystrokes into stickman martial arts strikes in real-time.
